Definition
[Vertical frame fields] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0443, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0444 1. appf:F.6\group Frame Bundle Calculus

For the standard matrix unit $e(a,b)\in \mathfrak {gl}(n,\mathbb R)$, define \[ \Lambda ^a_b(Y)=(\rho _Y)_*e(a,b). \] In local frame coordinates $y_a^i$, $\Lambda ^a_b=y_b^i\, \partial /\partial y_a^i$.
